_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG005 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG005.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG005.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG005.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Martyrium Ignatii Antiocheni (martyrium Antiochenum, 'Colbertinum')

incipit_checks.incipit: Ἄρτι διαδεξαμένου τὴν Ῥωμαίων ἀρχὴν Τραῖανοῦ, Ἰγνάτιος, ὁ τοῦ ἀποστόλου Ἰωάννου μαθητὴς

works.evidence: Exact incipit of the Martyrium Antiochenum at 499; ends at 503 with the relics, the date (πρὸ δεκατριῶν Καλανδῶν Ἰαννουαρίων), the dream-visions, and closing doxology. Loci 499-503 = Migne cols 979-988, matching the standard citation PG 5:979-988.

works.title: Fragmentum apologiae (apud Eusebium, HE 4.3)

incipit_checks.incipit: Τοῦ δὲ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν τὰ ἔργα ἀεὶ παρῆν ἀληθῆ γὰρ ἦν· οἱ θεραπευθέντες, οἱ ἀναστάντες ἐκ νεκρῶν

works.evidence: Single row: the famous sole fragment of Quadratus' Apology to Hadrian, verbatim (Eus. HE 4.3.2). Locus 642 = cols 1265-1266. No entry for the apologist Quadratus in the local TLG canon (only Gaius Asinius Quadratus the historian), hence NEW.
